notes: 5000 iid equal-weight complete rows from a transported population law; not a replay of the source or a validated estimate of the requested domain. Ferritin is RAW, with no CRP exclusion/correction. Two lognormal latent store components plus a modest inflammation multiplier give approximately GM 33.7 ug/L, 18.4% ferritin <15, and 2.7% >150. Hb has a positive-truncated normal distribution with a log-store deficit below 20 ug/L, independent residual heterogeneity, and an inflammation decrement. Deterministic population quadrature calibrates its two mean parameters to a chosen 5% anemia risk among raw ferritin >=15 and the original study's DERIVED CRUDE OR; no realized-table recentering or calibration. Spearman dependence is model-generated, not identified by a published Hb/ferritin correlation. All transport and latent-mixture settings are uncertain. Repeated virtual people add no empirical evidence.

provenance.limitations: This is one useful scenario, not an identified reconstruction. No target individual rows, target outcome summaries, stored estimates, or other constructors were accessed. No sampling-weight/age/parity/ethnicity-stratified model can be estimated from the available inputs. Abstract-only Canadian evidence limits assay and selection interpretation. Additional Australian abstract was read for context but no parameter was taken from it.

parameter_provenance.parameter: n_rows=5000; row_id1..5000; thresholds Hb12g/dL and raw ferritin15ug/L
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: Task contract; Hb conversion120g/L /10. Equal-weight iid law approximates the phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement population only by assumption.

parameter_provenance.parameter: Store component probability0.20, lognormal GMs7 and45ug/L, logSDs0.65 and0.55
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: A parsimonious two-stage depleted/replete mixture hand-selected to approximately align marginal raw ferritin with Canadian GM33.8, newer low-ferritin prevalence18.2%, older high-ferritin prevalence2.7%. These are not published latent components. Formula E[logF]=0.2log7+0.8log45+0.12log2. Low/high tail probabilities are weighted normal CDF mixtures.
parameter_provenance.transfer_assumptions: Canadian premenopausal/reproductive-age marginal iron status transported approximately to US20-44 in2021-23 despite different ethnicity, diet, contraception, period and complete-case selection. Marginal targets are not from a single identical source domain.

parameter_provenance.parameter: Inflammation Bernoulli0.12 independent of store component and logstores; ferritin multiplier2; Hb decrement0.45g/dL
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: Ferritin is an acute-phase reactant and inflammation can reduce erythropoiesis. Source did not measure inflammation; Canadian comparison shows correction changes prevalence. All numerical values and independence chosen, not estimated. This is a stylized latent phenotype, not CRP>5 prevalence.
parameter_provenance.transfer_assumptions: Retains inflammation phenotypes rather than imposing a CRP restriction; output ferritin remains uncorrected. No explicit obesity, chronic disease, ethnicity or selection model.

parameter_provenance.parameter: Hb | logstores Z, inflammation I: Normal(location=alpha-beta*max(0,log20-Z)-0.45I, SD0.9g/dL), truncated at0
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: Iron limitation affects Hb chiefly at depleted stores; Hb can vary substantially for noniron reasons. Original TableIII supports low-store/severe-anemia connection. Plateau knot20ug/L and residual SD0.9g/dL chosen, not inferred from CI. Residual contains demographic, noniron and assay variation; logSDs include ferritin heterogeneity/measurement scatter. All moments finite.

parameter_provenance.classification: ASSUMED transport of DERIVED crude source association
parameter_provenance.parameter: Reference anemia risk0.05 among raw ferritin>=15; OR=(173*1082)/(85*331)
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: 5% reference risk chosen below original85/1167=7.28% to represent a Western fortified-food/supplement setting; no matched empirical target estimate supports that exact reduction. Crude sourceOR6.653 transferred unchanged, not claimed biologically invariant. Low-ferritin anemia risk is OR*0.05/(0.95+OR*0.05), about0.259.
parameter_provenance.transfer_assumptions: Crude OR depends on covariate mix and measurement; constancy across countries and selection is a strong unverified assumption. Neither adjusted OR nor source marginal anemia transported.

parameter_provenance.parameter: alpha,beta: unique positive-slope roots of P(Hb<12|rawF>=15)=0.05 and P(Hb<12|rawF<15)=OR*0.05/(0.95+OR*0.05)
parameter_provenance.source_or_rationale: Computed from fixed population mixture integrals using200-node Gauss-Legendre quadrature per store/inflammation/threshold cell and Brent roots. Positive-truncation CDF evaluated stably. These are parameter calibrations, not adjustments to any realized rows; no seeds selected or data recentered.

requested_analyses.support: Source TableIV unadjusted count OR used as an explicit transported population constraint. Generated finite-sample OR is computed on exactly the returned rows, unadjusted; no continuity correction or zero-cell forcing in generator.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: Cross-population crude OR invariance, Hb reference risk, latent store shape, assay comparability, weight/complete-case selection.

requested_analyses.support: Model population probability P(rawF<15)*OR*0.05/(0.95+OR*0.05), approximately0.048; not a direct transfer of source173/1671. Canadian ferritin marginals plus assumed reference anemia risk determine the change.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: Joint prevalence not empirically identified for requested domain. Ferritin mixture and background anemia risk are uncertain; Monte Carlo rows do not resolve those uncertainties.

requested_analyses.support: Continuous nonlinear shared store mechanism plus inflammation phenotype and independent normal Hb residual produces rank dependence without imposing realized ranks; raw measurements, no log-ferritin correlation substituted.
requested_analyses.unresolved_dependencies: No usable source continuous Hb/ferritin rank correlation was reported in the read material. Slope calibration constrains threshold association but not continuous ranks; chosen residualSD, knot, mixture shapes and inflammatory coupling materially affect this analysis.
